text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine together with Matikane Tannhauser,
who hasn't been in the best shape lately.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall offer a prayer.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"*mumble mumble*... Please let me eat
lots of delicious food...!
Today I'm in the mood for pudding...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew. I hope it comes true.
choice_data_list: ...Didn't you come here to get in better shape?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ――Ah! That's right!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'll do it over, so please wait a moment!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
God, one more request, please.
I'm not quite feeling in top shape, so
please do something about it! Pretty please~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: All set! Now all that's left is to do our best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Come agaaaain?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It was from Fuku-chan-senpai!
She said her lucky item was pudding,
so she bought one for me while she was at it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
For my wish to come true so fast,
the blessing is already kicking in~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the pudding, God!
Next time, please give me strawberry shortcake!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this incident was a turning point, as Matikanetannhauser
got her groove back shortly afterward!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—Hm? Ooh~!
What a surprise, there's pudding on the ground!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Though it's just an empty container.
Did someone throw it away here...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Can't be helped. I'll pick it up and throw it in the trashâ

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!! Spideeer--!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
There's a spider in the container—! P-Please!
Spare my life, I beg of you—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Thank you so much for tossing it in the trash for me.
Trainer, you're a lifesaver.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Though, good things don't just happen
that easily, do they...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser felt discouraged,
and remained in a slump afterwards.
